correctness.rationale: For ordinary real G2 trace characters under probability Haar measure, exact Weyl constant-term calculation with all six positive-root pairs gives mixed degree-two, degree-four and degree-six moments, checked by an independently structured standalone integer convolution and nonaliasing torus-grid computation. Nonnegative tensor multiplicities force coefficient phases to align; strict terms ∫u³v=2 and ∫u⁵v=30 exclude other complex phases. Exact symbolic derivatives reduce global optimization to q4 and q6; each has precisely one positive zero by one Descartes sign change and endpoint signs. At ratio one q4(1)=1>0 and q6(1)=-29<0, proving the optimizer reversal without floating approximations. The finite checks certify polynomial inputs, while the analytic inequalities prove all complex coefficients.

value.rationale: The two fundamental characters are the complete canonical rank-two character packet of the smallest exceptional compact group. The theorem calculates two previously unmatched exact sharp L2-to-L4/L6 synthesis constants, classifies every complex extremizer, and proves a qualitative reversal from seven-dimensional to fourteen-dimensional fundamental character dominance between moments four and six. The reversal depends on competing character tensor multiplicities, not on a routine single-character moment or an arbitrary slice. No broader claims are made.
